name: hermes

hookActivation.recovery: Add AI-DLC's shell hooks to this profile's ~/.hermes/config.yaml under the hooks: block (pre_tool_call and post_tool_call entries pointing at the Hermes hook adapter), then run `hermes hooks doctor` to verify consent and allowlist status. For non-interactive runs set hooks_auto_accept: true or export HERMES_ACCEPT_HOOKS=1 before starting Hermes. Once the adapter is registered, exit Hermes and start it again in this folder, then type <entry>.
hookActivation.notRunYet: This is expected before your first Hermes chat in this folder with AI-DLC hooks configured. Add the hook entries to ~/.hermes/config.yaml, run `hermes hooks doctor` to approve them, then exit Hermes and start it again in this folder. Then run doctor again.
hookActivation.agentStep: Hermes is not running AI-DLC's hook adapter in this profile. First show the person this line: "Choose Yes when Hermes asks to approve the AI-DLC hook command, then answer the question below." Then add the pre_tool_call and post_tool_call shell-hook entries to `~/.hermes/config.yaml` pointing at the Hermes hook adapter, keep every other key as it is, and run `hermes hooks doctor`; Hermes asks the person before it approves each new hook. It works in this chat: do not ask for a restart and do not mention Hermes hook settings beyond the config.yaml edit. Then run <next> and act on what it returns, so the waiting question shows again. If it brings back this same message, the hooks are still not approved: show this line instead and end your turn: "Hermes is still starting with AI-DLC hooks unapproved. Run `hermes hooks doctor` to approve them, then start Hermes again in this folder and type <entry>."

registration.missing: ~/.hermes/config.yaml is missing from this profile, so Hermes runs none of AI-DLC's hooks here. In a terminal, <repair>, then exit Hermes and start it again in this folder, and type <entry>.
registration.invalid: Hermes cannot read this profile's ~/.hermes/config.yaml because it is not valid YAML, so it runs none of AI-DLC's hooks here. Correct the file, then exit Hermes and start it again in this folder, and type <entry>.
